structure: Single combined K-12 PDF (Tennessee Academic Standards for Social Studies, adopted 2024, effective 2027-28). Front matter (u1-u275): table of contents, introduction/process, how-to-read, Table 1 (grade titles and descriptions K-8), Table 2 (high-school course codes, titles, descriptions), Table 3 (i.e./e.g./such as conventions), Table 4 (seven content strands C,E,G,H,P,T,TCA), Table 5 (six Social Studies Practices SSP.01-SSP.06 in grade bands K-2, 3-5, 6-8, 9-12), narrative on literacy, geography, Tennessee history and civics requirements. Grade/course sections follow, each starting with a title unit ('K | KINDERGARTEN...', '1 | FIRST GRADE...', ... '8 | EIGHTH GRADE...', then 'Grades 9-12 AAH | AFRICAN AMERICAN HISTORY' and 'AH | ANCIENT HISTORY', CI, E, P, S, TN, GC, US, WG, W), a Course Description paragraph, and a repeating page footer legend of strand codes (C/E/G/H/P/T/TCA). Each grade or course repeats the applicable SSP table (K-2 copy in K, 1, 2; 3-5 copy in 3, 4, 5; 6-8 copy in 6, 7, 8; 9-12 copy in every HS course) introduced by an 'Social Studies Practices Overview' note. Content is organised into topics (era or domain), each introduced by a unit 'Topic title Overview: ...' (or a separate heading unit followed by 'Overview: ...'), then a table with columns Standard Number | Content Standard | Content Strand. Standard codes are grade.number for K-8 (K.01, 3.14, 8.74; grade 5 spans Part 1 Tennessee History 5.01-5.31 and Part 2 Geography 5.32-5.46) and COURSE.number for HS courses (AAH.01-56, AH.01-60, CI.01-22, E.01-47, P.01-61, S.01-43, TN.01-67, GC.01-47, US.01-94, WG.01-46, W.01-76). K-2 tables have no strand column (strands are the topic headings Culture, Economics, Geography, Government and Civics, History). Examples/lists appear inline inside standards text with 'e.g.', 'i.e.', 'including:' and bullet lists, so are not separate units. T.C.A. statute citations are inline in standards text. In extraction, the code cell is often placed after (or on a different row than) its standard text cell in the HS tables and in grades 5-8, so the code and text units are adjacent but code order can be shifted by one row; both are labeled standards for the same topic.

issues: u1-u24: Table of contents labeled backup; page numbers refer to the printed document, not the unit order.

Social Studies Practices (SSP.01-SSP.06) are repeated verbatim in every grade/course section. Each in-section copy is labeled with that section's grade (K, 1, 2, 3, ... 8) or HS course (grades 9-12 with course set); the master Table 5 (u194-u241) is additionally labeled standards with band ranges K-2, 3-5, 6-8, 9-12 (code cells K-12). Assembler may see duplicate SSP text in a grade row because of both Table 5 and the section copy.

Topic units of the form 'Topic title Overview: ...' merge a topic heading with its overview narrative; because units are not split they are labeled standards (heading + overview). Units that begin with 'Overview:' (heading is a separate unit) are labeled examples (topic overview narrative) and the separate heading unit is standards. Impact: overview narrative text sits in standards for most topics.

u1633: 'Overview: ...' unit also contains the trailing sub-heading text 'The Renaissance' (extraction merged the sub-heading into the overview); labeled examples. Sub-headings u1654 (The Protestant Reformation) and u1678 (The Scientific Revolution) are standards headings under Early Modern Europe.

Grade titles merged with course description in one unit (u361, u455, u560, u721, u930, u1081, u1147, u1746, u2326, u3091) are labeled standards (title + description mixed); the description-only units (starting 'Course Description:') are examples.

Table 1 (u61-u89) and Table 2 (u95-u127) course/grade descriptions in the front matter labeled examples (descriptive narrative, duplicating section course descriptions); Table 1 grade 5 rows u76-u80 cover Part 1 and Part 2, both grade 5.
Grade 5 is split into Part 1 Tennessee History (5.01-5.31, u930-u1080) and Part 2 Geography (5.32-5.46, u1081-u1146); both labeled grade 5, course null (they are parts of a grade, not named courses).
Grades 6, 7, 8 titles are 'World History and Geography...' / 'United States History and Geography...' but are grade-level content: course null.

HS course strings follow Table 2 titles with credit/asterisk notes removed: Economics, United States Government and Civics, United States History and Geography: Post-Reconstruction to the Present, World History and Geography: The Industrial Revolution to the Contemporary World. Table 2 lists the civics course code as 'GC' and the sections also use GC.

Table column header cells (Standard, Content Standard, Content Strand, Number, Practice, Social Studies Practice, Standard Number) and the repeated strand-key page footer ('C-Culture, E-Economics, ...') are labeled backup in the surrounding grade/course.
u2029 (8.63): standard text split across table cells u2027 and u2029 ('...decision to' / 'secede.'); both standards.

HS course tables (AAH u2099-u2325, AH, CI, E, P, S, TN, GC, US, WG, W) and grade-5 topics: the code cell (e.g. AAH.03, E.13, P.11) is often on a different row than its text, usually following its text unit, and sometimes a code or text appears with no adjacent partner (e.g. u2112-u2113 AAH.03/AAH.04 around text u2110; u2770 E.13; u2812 E.25). Every text and code unit is labeled standards; pair codes to text by order within the topic table, not adjacency.
u4733-u4734: code 'W.74' split into two cells ('W.' and '74'); standards.
Content-strand cells with typos/odd spacing (u1024 'C. H.P, T,', u3317 'C. E, G, H, P, T', u4388 'E, G,') kept as-is, labeled standards.
u2021, u2025, u2028, u2032, u2035, u2038, u2041 (8.62-8.67): strand cell appears in column C7 instead of C5; table layout shifted, grade 8 Civil War topic.

Multi-column bullet lists are flattened in interleaved order in some standards (e.g. u1831 8.16, u4023 US.50, u4133 US.77, u4166 US.84, u4186 US.89, u4587 W.39, u4637 W.52), so bullet items appear out of reading order; each kept as a single standards unit.

State guide check: guide says grade groupings [0]..[9-12] with 'Grade 5 split into two parts' - confirmed; electives and courses are all 9-12; guide mentions Geography/History/Civics topics - confirmed. Psychology, Sociology, African American History, Contemporary Issues, Ancient History, Economics, Tennessee History, US Government and Civics, US History and Geography, World Geography, World History and Geography are the 11 HS courses. Appendix A (CCSSO graphic, intro) is referenced but not present in the text.
Civics requirements text (u273-u275: T.C.A. civics assessment, citizenship/immigration test) and Tennessee history requirements (u257-u272) are statutory/context narrative, labeled backup.
